reviews.title: ••• Need to Remove AI •••
reviews.text:
AI makes Note Update Very Difficult - was not without AI 
How do I remove AI from Secure Notepad? HELP

reviews.title: WTF
reviews.text: I suddenly find all my notes being held hostage unless I pay $9.99. I searched my email and found my original purchase receipt from 2013 for unlimited use. I tried “restore purchases “ that was mentioned in another review to no avail. So now I’m just out of 13 years of notes? WTF.

reviews.title: Pretty Good But
reviews.text: Okay so I like the app it’s great. There’s no lag its password protected and overall great But why do I have to pay for more storage? I read another answer to another review that said the notes are store on the phone itself so why do I have to pay to store more notes on MY PHONE guess I’ll have to find a different app.

reviews.title: Locked out of my notes
reviews.text: I don’t have access to my notes and it says there is a limit to unlock them unless i pay

reviews.title: Found a way to bypass the encryption
reviews.text: Indirectly, by accident, I discovered vulnerability that bypasses the encryption passcode/password when opening the app. Connecting it to the new Apple Devices app, initiating an encrypted backup and canceling the backup to PC mid-way. Once reopening the app there is no password prompt and I had direct access to all my notes. And I hadn’t opened this app in over 6 months. I’m not so confident about this app any longer.

reviews.title: Locked out
reviews.text: I can not access my app. Pads does not work no more

reviews.title: Don’t forget your password!
reviews.text: If you forget your password on this app there is absolutely no way to reset it and now I can’t even get into my own app
